change.after: "SHA-384 for 3072-bit RSA keys, SHA-512 for 4096-bit RSA keys"

exposure.needed: which Certificates use RSA keys of size 3072 or 4096 and whether consumers support SHA-384/SHA-512 signatures

consequence.statement: RSA certificates with 3072/4096-bit keys are signed with SHA-384/SHA-512 as they rotate; widely supported, but errors may appear with clients that don't support these hashes.

assertion.statement: RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys are now signed with SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively, which may cause errors with peers that don't support these hashes as keys rotate.
